newsitem.title: USA: Laboratory Corp amends credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Laboratory Corp amends credit facility.

text.p: Laboratory Corp of America Holdings said Friday it entered into an amended and restated credit agreement with its current lenders, making available a term loan facility of about $654 million and a revolving credit facility of $450 million.
The agreement terms are based on the current structure of the company's rights offering and will become effective on completion of the offering.
Lab Corp posted first-quarter revenues of $391.5 million, compared to $403.9 million last year.

First-quarter operating income was $27.8 million and net income was $2.4 million, or $0.02 per share, compared to operating income of $27.8 million and net income of $5.9 million, or $0.05 per share last year.
